reference_sql:
SELECT promo_code,
       200 * (1 - discount_pct / 100) * 0.95 AS member_price_eur,
       (200 - 200 * (1 - discount_pct / 100) * 0.95) / 200 * 100 AS member_off_pct
FROM promotions
